title: Tthe data is not transferred from the init container to the application (regular) container on the volume.
body:
### Issue Description

The problem indicated in notification no. #29555 was only partially corrected by the modification in main.
Finally, tempfs can be seen in the application container (regular) on the volume created by the init container.
This is not enough, because the data placed there by the init container (e.g. secret - key used for encryption) is no longer found there by the main container.

We are attaching a sample and test.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Use Podmain (see Additional environment details)
Run ./test.sh.
The test creates an isolated Podman storage, pulls busybox:latest, and runs podman kube play tmpfs-test.yaml.
The init container writes Secret-Data-123 to /run/secret.
The regular container reads /run/secret and reports the filesystem type and contents.
Observe that /run/secret is mounted as tmpfs, but the data written by the init container is missing.
The test reports:
DATA: MISSING
[FAIL] init data NOT shared (DATA=MISSING) — the tmpfs patch is missing


### Describe the results you received

The test fails because the emptyDir tmpfs is not shared correctly between the init container and the regular container.
The observed output is:
DATA: MISSING
FSLINE: tmpfs                tmpfs          65536         0     65536   0% /run/secret

[FAIL] init data NOT shared (DATA=MISSING) — the tmpfs patch is missing


### Describe the results you expected

The init container writes Secret-Data-123 to /run/secret, and the regular container should be able to read the same data from the same emptyDir volume.

The volume should remain available for the lifetime of the pod, and /run/secret should be backed by tmpfs with the configured 64 MiB sizeLimit.
